1.b4 c6 2.Bb2.strategy: Completes the idea of the opening: the bishop takes the long diagonal toward Black's kingside. The b4-pawn has no pawn protection, so White must be ready to advance or support it when Black attacks it from the flank.

1.b4 c6 2.Bb2 a5.strategy: Attacks the b4-pawn with the a-pawn and forces White to decide at once whether to advance it, support it or give it up. Black contests White's space on the flank instead of the centre, at the cost of loosening its own queenside.
